# pvecli cluster ha

Arm or disarm the whole HA stack (PVE 9.2+).

## disarm

Disarm HA cluster wide: release every watchdog before maintenance.

```text
pvecli cluster ha disarm [OPTIONS]
```

### Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `-m`, `--mode VALUE` | `freeze` | freeze: keep every HA resource where it is. ignore: let them be managed by hand. |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Skip confirmation. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` |  | Profile to use. |

## arm

Re-arm HA after a disarm.

```text
pvecli cluster ha arm [OPTIONS]
```

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
